config system dhcp server
    edit 3
        set dns-service default
        set default-gateway 192.0.2.1
        set netmask 255.255.255.0
        set interface "quarantine"
        config ip-range
            edit 1
                set start-ip 192.0.2.2
                set end-ip 192.0.2.254
            next
        end
        set timezone-option default
        config reserved-address
            edit 1
                set ip 192.0.2.220
                set mac 00:00:5e:00:53:01
                set description "netops-dhcp-dns test"
            next
        end
    next
end
